about.title: About me
paragraphs: I'm a software engineer based in Germany. I was born in Brazil and started my career there, at the Brazilian subsidiary of a German company. They invited me to their headquarters when I was 21; I went back a year later to finish my degree, then returned in 2019 and have stayed since.

I work across the stack, though the front end is where I'm most at home. At DocuWare I lead the Client Solutions team, which builds the self-service portals our partners and direct customers use. Most of my time goes to the people and the planning now, but I still write code for about a fifth of it — ASP.NET Core and F# behind, React and TypeScript in front, running on Azure.

I'm communicative and I enjoy working in a team; I believe that together we're stronger. I try to stay organised, and I like sharing what I know. I hold a bachelor's degree in Computer Science from PUCRS, and I speak Portuguese natively and English fluently, alongside Spanish and German.

Away from the keyboard I'm usually playing guitar, gaming, watching a series, or having a mate tea in a park. My happiest memories are the ones with my family and friends around. If I made someone's life better, then it was worth it.
